author: Josan
description: A fragrant, creamy yogurt-based drink infused with rose syrup — a floral twist on the traditional Punjabi lassi.
ingredients: Chopped pistachios or rose petals (for garnish)
instructions: In a blender, combine yogurt, cold water or milk, rose syrup, and sugar.
Add ice cubes and blend again briefly.
Pour into glasses and garnish with chopped pistachios or edible rose petals.
